newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,909 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,909 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,909 contracts compared with 1,167 overnight Thursday.
There were 266 wheat, 405 corn, 1,036 soybean, 81 soymeal, 111 soyoil, one oat, one wheat put, two corn calls and six soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 cent higher to 1-1/4 lower, corn was steady to 1-1/2 cents lower and soybeans were three to 6-3/4 cents lower.
